e.title: demofit (R)
e.summary: 参数死亡率曲线拟合与死亡率预测 R 包：Tabeau/Renshaw-Haberman/Cairns/Li-Lee 经典模型
e.body: demofit 是新加坡管理大学 Jackie Li 开发的参数死亡率建模工具：拟合参数死亡率曲线（含多种优化策略增强稳健性），并基于死亡率曲线引导进行死亡率预测。方法引用经典文献：Tabeau (2001)、Renshaw & Haberman (2006)、Cairns et al. (2009)、Li & Lee (2005)——寿险定价与长寿风险研究的教科书级方法集。GPL-3。与 [[mortalitylaws]]（参数死亡率模型+HMD）、[[stmomo]]（随机死亡率建模）互补。关联 [[longevity]]、[[elect]]、[[lifecontingencies]]、[[mortsoa]]。
e.verified_note: CRAN DESCRIPTION 核实：v0.1.5，Jackie Li (SMU)，参数死亡率拟合+预测，引用 Tabeau 2001/Renshaw-Haberman 2006/Cairns 2009/Li-Lee 2005，GPL-3
e.summary_en: R package for parametric mortality curve fitting and mortality forecasting: classic Tabeau/Renshaw-Haberman/Cairns/Li-Lee models
e.summary_hk: 參數死亡率曲線擬合與死亡率預測 R 包：Tabeau/Renshaw-Haberman/Cairns/Li-Lee 經典模型
e.body_en: demofit is a parametric mortality modelling tool by Jackie Li (Singapore Management University): it fits parametric mortality curves (with multiple optimisation strategies for robust estimation) and forecasts mortality guided by those curves. Methods reference the classic literature: Tabeau (2001), Renshaw & Haberman (2006), Cairns et al. (2009), Li & Lee (2005) — a textbook-grade set for life-insurance pricing and longevity-risk research. GPL-3. Complements [[mortalitylaws]] (parametric mortality models + HMD) and [[stmomo]] (stochastic mortality modelling). Related: [[longevity]], [[elect]], [[lifecontingencies]], [[mortsoa]].
e.body_hk: demofit 是新加坡管理大學 Jackie Li 開發的參數死亡率建模工具：擬合參數死亡率曲線（含多種優化策略增強穩健性），並基於死亡率曲線引導進行死亡率預測。方法引用經典文獻：Tabeau (2001)、Renshaw & Haberman (2006)、Cairns et al. (2009)、Li & Lee (2005)——壽險定價與長壽風險研究的教科書級方法集。GPL-3。與 [[mortalitylaws]]（參數死亡率模型+HMD）、[[stmomo]]（隨機死亡率建模）互補。關聯 [[longevity]]、[[elect]]、[[lifecontingencies]]、[[mortsoa]]。
